description: (Na₂WHO₄)₂H₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. The structure consists of eight H₂ clusters inside a Na₂WHO₄ framework. In each H₂ cluster, H is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the Na₂WHO₄ framework, there are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one H and three O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.59 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.31 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one H and four O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.69 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.85 Å. H is bonded in a water-like geometry to two Na atoms. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃W trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom.
